hotels.title: Barossa Valley Contemporary Wine Country Retreat with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: In the heart of South Australia’s wine country, Mercure Barossa Valley is a stylish stay with easy access to the Barossa Valley’s famous cellar doors. Here, every room and apartment is dressed to the nines with ultra-chic furnishings and all the comforts of home, paired perfectly with serene views of the hotel's lush gardens. With more than 150 wineries across the region and Adelaide only about an hour away, it's the perfect base for exploring into the Barossa’s cellar doors, food scene and heritage towns. Back at the hotel, savour pub-style classics at the onsite restaurant, or continue your wine tasting adventure at the bar and wine room.
